props.heading: Rooted in values, growing into the future
props.subheading: Greenfield Demo School is a fictional CBSE school from Nursery to Class 12, created to show what a school website on ShikshaBlox looks like.

props.heading: A school where every child is seen
props.html:
At Greenfield, learning goes beyond the textbook. Small sections, caring teachers and a balanced timetable help every child build strong academics, good character and the confidence to lead.

From our Nursery wing to the senior school, children learn through enquiry, projects, sport and the arts.

props.heading: Why families choose Greenfield
props.intro: Everything a growing child needs, on one safe and green campus.

items.title: Small sections
items.text: No more than 32 children per section, so teachers know every student well.

items.title: CBSE with NEP 2020
items.text: Competency-based learning, holistic report cards and plenty of hands-on projects.

items.title: Science & coding
items.text: Modern science labs and a computer lab with coding from Class 3.

items.title: Sport every day
items.text: Athletics track, sports ground and coaches for cricket, football and athletics.

items.title: Arts & music
items.text: Music, dance, theatre and art studios to discover every talent.

items.title: Safe transport
items.text: GPS-tracked buses with a staff member on every route.

props.heading: Four green acres built for learning
props.html: Bright classrooms, a glass-walled library, science and computer labs, a junior playground and a full sports ground — designed so children love coming to school.

props.heading: Admissions are open for 2027–28
props.text: This is a demo. On your school's website, this button sends parents straight to your admissions enquiry form.

props.heading: Twenty years of joyful learning
props.subheading: Greenfield Demo School is a fictional school created to demonstrate ShikshaBlox. Everything here shows what your school's own story could look like.

props.heading: Nursery to Class 12, on one campus
props.html:
Greenfield follows the CBSE curriculum in English medium, with Hindi and Telugu as languages. Children move from a play-based early years wing to a primary school focused on foundations, and on to a senior school offering Science, Commerce and Humanities.

Our teachers are trained every year in modern pedagogy, and our parents are partners in everything we do.

items.title: Care
items.text: Every child is known, valued and safe.

items.title: Curiosity
items.text: We ask questions and learn by doing.

items.title: Integrity
items.text: We are honest and fair in all we do.

items.title: Service
items.text: We use our gifts to help others.

props.heading: Welcome to Greenfield
props.html:
Dear parents,

Thank you for your interest in Greenfield. Our aim is simple: that every child leaves us confident, kind and ready for the world.

We combine strong academics with sport, the arts and service, and we keep you informed every step of the way — through the parent app, WhatsApp updates and regular meetings.

Please visit us and see our classrooms for yourself.

The Principal
Greenfield Demo School

This message is sample content for the ShikshaBlox demo.

items.title: Vision
items.text: To nurture confident, compassionate learners who think for themselves and serve their communities.

items.title: Mission
items.text: To offer a balanced, child-centred education that builds strong foundations, character and curiosity in a safe and joyful school.

props.heading: Strong foundations, real-world learning
props.html: Greenfield follows the CBSE curriculum aligned with the National Education Policy 2020. Lessons are activity-based in the early years and become increasingly project- and enquiry-led as children grow.

items.title: Early years (Nursery – UKG)
items.text: Play-based learning, early literacy and numeracy, music and movement.

items.title: Primary (Classes 1 – 5)
items.text: Reading, writing and number sense, EVS, languages, art and plenty of activities.

items.title: Middle & senior (Classes 6 – 12)
items.text: Sciences, mathematics, social sciences and languages; Science, Commerce and Humanities streams in Classes 11–12.

items.title: Coding & robotics
items.text: Computational thinking from Class 3.

items.title: Languages
items.text: English, Hindi and Telugu.

items.title: Performing arts
items.text: Music, dance and theatre.

items.title: Sport
items.text: Daily games and inter-house competitions.

props.html:
Documents required

  • Birth certificate of the child
  • Aadhaar of the child and a parent (if available)
  • Transfer certificate and previous report card (Class 1 and above)
  • Two passport-size photographs

faqs.title: Is Greenfield a real school?
faqs.summary: No. Greenfield Demo School is a fictional school that shows what a website built on ShikshaBlox looks like.

faqs.title: Which board does the school follow?
faqs.summary: The demo school follows the CBSE curriculum. ShikshaBlox supports CBSE, ICSE, State Boards and international curricula.

faqs.title: How do I apply for admission?
faqs.summary: Send an enquiry from the Admissions page. On a real ShikshaBlox site, it arrives instantly in the school's Studio inbox.

faqs.title: Is school transport available?
faqs.summary: Yes, the demo school runs GPS-tracked buses across the city.
